$comment: Reconstructed territory ownership for 22 Dec 2014 – 3 Jan 2018, the period before territory_exchanges begins. Three anchors are copies of the game's own territory list (23 and 24 Dec 2014, Wynncraft/WynncraftAPI-Docs commits d040b49 and 8bd8d05; 13 Jun 2016, Fandom User:Syaoran3 revision 10278) and are exact apart from territories that no longer exist, which are not drawn. The rest are built from labelled map screenshots, one archived leaderboard capture, in-game screenshots, guild tags on territory boss bars in archived gameplay videos (listed in each such anchor's sources) and dated forum statements; see the anchor notes. No tile is in play before its region opened: Gavel on 28 Aug 2016, Corkus on 7 Apr 2017. Every tile carries a provenance code: 2 attested (a source names that tile and holder), 1 inferred (an account places the guild in that region), 0 guessed. Dated anchors are whole UTC days; an anchor taken from a timed capture carries its full UTC instant. Edit anchors with care, then run scripts/clump-pre2018-reconstruction.cjs to re-place guessed tiles.

anchors.label: Guilds are released
anchors.note: Version 1.13 adds guilds and guild wars. No territory is held by anyone on this day. Nether's Ascent and Holders of LE were created the day before, Kangronomicon on the 23rd, HackForums on the 24th and TheNoLifes on the 27th. Who took what over the following months was never written down.

anchors.label: The map is claimed
anchors.note: Guild warfare opened the day before, and by the morning of the 23rd almost the whole province had an owner. No guild held more than a tenth of it: Holders of LE and Chex Mix had thirteen territories each, Surge twelve and CapaCactusClan eleven, with some thirty other guilds holding the rest. Seven territories were still unclaimed. This frame is the territory list the game itself published at 10:05 UTC that morning.

anchors.label: Surge on top
anchors.note: A day later the map had already turned over. Surge had nearly doubled to twenty-three territories, Cats of Wynn held ten and Nether's Ascent nine, while Holders of LE and Chex Mix had lost almost everything they held the morning before. More than fifty guilds held at least one territory. This frame is the game's own territory list for that day.

anchors.label: A crowded map
anchors.note: Four weeks in, no guild stood out. Guild tags on territory boss bars filmed in the first three weeks of January show Pirates of Wynn and Wynn Theory around Ragni, Cats of Wynn in Ragni and Rymek, Terrian on Volcano Island and a dozen other guilds with one territory each, five of them founded that month. Twenty-one territories are placed from that footage; the rest are carried over from December and are guesses.

anchors.label: Imperial in Detlas
anchors.note: By early February Imperial held Detlas, its inner suburb, Elkurn and Jungle Upper, and Pirates of Wynn had moved east to Bremminglar, Cathedral Harbour and the Nesaak bridge. Nether's Ascent held the middle of the jungle and Surge two territories in the desert and Rymek. Twenty-three territories are placed from boss bars in three videos uploaded between 2 and 10 February; the rest are guesses.

anchors.label: Nether's Ascent spreads
anchors.note: By early March Nether's Ascent held Ragni Main Entrance, the Pigmen Ravines and Dead Island, and a guild tagged CSQ, which no longer exists and has not been identified, had taken the Detlas outskirts, Maltic Plains and Emerald Trail. KnightOfValor, founded in mid-January, held four territories from Katoa Ranch to the Nether, and Detlas itself had passed to Frosted Pants. Thirty-seven territories are placed from boss bars filmed between mid-February and early March; the rest are guesses.

anchors.label: Imperial and Nether's Ascent
anchors.note: Through April Nether's Ascent held the Nether gate and plains, two desert territories and City of Troms, and Imperial held Elkurn, Jungle Lake, Jungle Upper and the Nesaak bridge. KnightOfValor held Nivla Woods and Emerald Trail, and Kangronomicon two territories in the jungle. Nineteen territories are placed from boss bars filmed between mid-March and early May; the rest are guesses.

anchors.label: Two powers
anchors.note: By the end of July two guilds held almost every territory anyone filmed. Nether's Ascent had the whole desert, Rymek, Elkurn, the Nether plains and Nesaak, and Kangronomicon had Detlas, Nemract, Selchar, the Ragni approaches and the Ternaves plains. Forty-seven territories are placed from boss bars in twenty-six videos filmed in July; the rest are guesses.

anchors.label: Holders of LE at their height
anchors.note: Holders of LE hold a contiguous block of roughly 24 tiles across Nemract, Detlas and Nivla. Kangronomicon hold the Ragni and Maltic side; Nether's Ascent the eastern Nether and Nesaak block.

anchors.label: Concordia at its peak
anchors.note: Validus and Travellers hold the overwhelming majority of Wynn. Holders of LE are reduced to a five-tile Detlas pocket and Kangronomicon appear nowhere on the map. Six territories are placed from boss bars filmed in the second half of September.

anchors.label: HackForums in the desert
anchors.note: In January Kangronomicon held Ragni, Maltic and the plains out to Emerald Trail, HackForums held Almuj and the desert, ToastedPandas held Detlas and its suburbs, Sinners held Nivla Woods and The Plebs held Nemract. Forty-three territories are placed from boss bars in fourteen videos filmed between 28 December and 30 January; the rest follow the map either side and are guesses. The February anchor puts the desert under HaHaUnited, so either it changed hands within a fortnight or that inference is wrong.

anchors.label: Ordo Malleus at its height
anchors.note: Every member guild holds its designated block.

anchors.label: The map before Hax
anchors.note: Transcribed from the screenshot recovered from the forums. UltimateXeons are the most visible holder and HackForums are one power among many. Blacklisted hold the entire ocean. Six territories are checked against boss bars in a video filmed on 2 April.

anchors.label: Nether's Ascent return
anchors.note: Nether's Ascent took fifty-one territories in the four days before this frame, nearly all of the desert, Nesaak, the jungle, Troms, Rymek and the islands. HackForums, which had held ninety-four on 8 June, were down to thirty-seven in Ragni, Detlas and Nivla, and TitanZ held twenty-one. The Gavel territories were already listed but could not yet be taken. This frame is the game's own territory list at 11:11 UTC.

anchors.label: UltimateXeons and Libertas
anchors.note: UltimateXeons held the centre of Wynn from Detlas to Elkurn and every island but Selchar; Libertas held Nesaak, Rymek, the jungle and Troms. DwarvenKingdom had the north-eastern desert and Nemract, and HackForums were down to about a dozen territories in the desert and the far west. Read from a guild-map screenshot posted that morning; a few territories under overlapping labels are guessed.

anchors.label: HackForums back in Ragni
anchors.note: By the second week of August HackForums held the Ragni entrances and suburbs, Katoa Ranch, Maltic Plains and Elkurn Fields, KnightOfValor held Nivla Woods and GuildOlab Emerald Trail. Twelve territories are placed from boss bars in seven videos filmed between 8 August and 1 September; the rest follow the map either side and are guesses.

anchors.label: The leaderboard capture
anchors.note: The only machine-readable record before 2018 gives totals and never says which tiles. HackForums hold 146 of 332, Libertas 60, UltimateXeons 53. Sixty-one territories are placed from boss bars filmed between 7 September and 8 October; the rest is a guess that honours the counts and keeps blocs contiguous.

anchors.label: Libertas in Rymek and Nesaak
anchors.note: In late October HackForums held the jungle, Troms, Efilim and Almuj, Libertas held Rymek, Nesaak and Twain Lake, Blacklisted the ocean islands and Maro Peaks, and UltimateXeons Olux, Gelibord and Kandon-Beda. Forty territories are placed from boss bars in thirteen videos filmed between 10 October and 9 November; the rest follow the map either side and are guesses.

anchors.label: UltimateXeons in the Light Realm
anchors.note: Going into December UltimateXeons held the Light Realm, Olux, Lexdale and Ahmsord, Libertas the Dark Forest, Guild Hall and Cinfras as well as Rymek and Nesaak, and Beasts held Detlas and Troms. HackForums held the desert, Nivla, the Ragni approaches and the Pigmen Ravines. Fifty-eight territories are placed from boss bars in twenty-one videos filmed between 14 November and 24 December; the rest follow the map either side and are guesses.

anchors.label: HackForums across Wynn
anchors.note: By late January HackForums held almost every territory filmed in Wynn, from Ragni and Detlas through Nemract, Nivla, Elkurn and the Nether to Nesaak and the jungle, as well as Selchar. Blacklisted kept the volcano and Dead Island, UltimateXeons the Light Realm, and a guild tagged OUp, which no longer exists and has not been identified, held six territories from Katoa Ranch to the Nesaak plains. Seventy-one territories are placed from boss bars in twenty-eight videos filmed between 15 January and 15 February; the rest follow the map either side and are guesses.

anchors.label: Two hundred clear of second
anchors.note: On 1 March Drew1011 writes that a single guild "can now hold all of the Wynn territories and quite a lot of the Gavel territories". A fortnight later an applicant calls it "the #1 guild by leaps and bounds with over 200 more territories than the second place guild". Libertas, which had been second, fell to twelfth and lost everything. Forty-five territories are placed from boss bars filmed between 28 February and 29 March; the rest are guesses.

anchors.label: Libertas in Corkus
anchors.note: Within two weeks of Corkus opening Libertas held Corkus City, the sea port and the factory as well as Cinfras. HackForums held Ragni, Detlas, Nemract, Nesaak and the Pigmen Ravines, and Blacklisted the volcano and Dead Island. Fifty-eight territories are placed from boss bars in twenty videos filmed between 4 April and 12 May; the rest follow the map either side and are guesses.

anchors.label: The record
anchors.note: HackForums' own recruitment thread advertises "#1 Guild on the statistics board holding 300+ territories", and dated quotes of it carry that line from 15 June. Three weeks earlier an outsider had asked why Hax held more than 300 when a mob-spawning bug stopped anyone else taking any. The maximum was later recalled as close to 350, which was very nearly the whole map. Forty-seven territories are placed from boss bars filmed between 19 May and 26 June; the rest are guesses.

anchors.label: The claim slips
anchors.note: A HackForums member answers a challenge to their own banner: "We still are #1, and we still do have 9x more than the guild in second, even if it is less than 300." The 300+ line was gone from the opening post by 18 October. War Syndicate had been created the day before, on 17 July, expressly to bring them down. Sixty-three territories are placed from boss bars filmed between 5 July and 18 August; the rest are guesses.

anchors.label: HackForums still hold Wynn
anchors.note: Through late August and September HackForums held nearly every territory anyone filmed, from Ragni to the Light Forest, and Paladins United held Gelibord, Ahmsord, Selchar and the Corkus coast. The first footage of a broken-up map is from 30 September. Eighty-five territories are placed from boss bars in seventeen videos filmed between 26 August and 24 September; the rest are carried over from July and are guesses.

anchors.label: Wynn before the Coalition
anchors.note: Ownership is fragmented across roughly a dozen guilds, several of them later War Syndicate members. Eighteen territories are placed from boss bars filmed on 30 September, the first footage to show the break-up; the rest are guesses.

anchors.label: The Coalition divides the mainland
anchors.note: On 22 November the Coalition published the map it had drawn up for itself, assigning each member a region: Kingdom Phoenixes the desert and savannah, Gilded Sparrows Detlas and the Nether, Kingdom Foxes Nesaak and the mining base, Hall of Fame Ragni. This frame follows that plan. How closely it was kept is not known, and in-game screenshots from the following weeks show Detlas held by House of Sentinels, Kingdom Foxes and HackForums in turn. Titans Valor held the Durum Isles and The Mage Legacy Mage Island. Gavel was still War Syndicate ground.

anchors.label: Gavel at the invasion's start
anchors.note: War Syndicate guilds hold the province of Gavel on the day the Coalition declares war. Wynn follows the Coalition's November plan, which was never kept exactly.

anchors.label: Gavel taken
anchors.note: The Coalition holds all 349 territories. Paladins United take the whole Light Realm; Kingdom Foxes run through the centre and west.
